lines.text: Now the real Java. Drive To Tag, line twenty seven, extends Drive To Pose, so it inherits the whole driving loop from video two.
It keeps the drivetrain, the tag's ID, tag to goal, one tag tracker, and the map goal.
The constructor saves them; line forty eight builds a tag tracker fed by every camera that might see it.
Initialize runs once at the start. Line fifty three forgets any old estimate, so every approach starts fresh.
Lines fifty five to fifty eight: the map goal is the tag's map pose composed with tag to goal. Here, thirteen point six seven, four point one seven.
No map entry? The goal is wherever the robot is, so it holds still until the cameras lock.
Execute runs fifty times a second: line sixty four feeds new photos to the tracker first, then line sixty five drives.
Goal, line seventy, is the whole handoff: the tag's goal if the tracker has one, otherwise the map goal. After the lock, the goal hops four centimeters.
And line seventy five: finished only when locked and arrived. The robot never finishes on the map's guess.
